description: Listed Building Consent for the demolition and replacement of outbuildings with single storey side extension, basement extension, replacement of windows, other associated refurbishment works, internal and external alterations. (Basement rooflight in raised flowerbed and changes to side extension glazed doors and screen of planting).
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved plans, rainwater goods on listed buildings must only be replaced with cast iron.
